## Give Your AI Agent Superpowers

Search, install, and share AI Skills. Sync across devices. One command via NyxID.

Ornn is an independent Skill-as-a-Service platform. It works best through NyxID.

## What You Can Do

::: {.features-grid}
::: {.feature-card}
### Create Posters & Videos

Your AI agent finds the right skill, runs it, and delivers the result. No manual setup.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Build Presentations

Use NotebookLM and other skills to create polished presentations from your data.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Work Through Lark & Slack

Connect your agent to your team tools. Pull data, send messages, manage tasks.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Pull Any Data You Need

Your agent searches, filters, and delivers data from any connected service.
:::
:::

## Get Started

**With NyxID (recommended):**

```bash
Read https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChronoAIProject/NyxID/main/skills/nyxid/SKILL.md and install the NyxID skill following its setup instructions.
```

Your agent installs NyxID, connects to Ornn, and gets access to all available skills automatically.

**Without NyxID:**

Visit [ornn.chrono-ai.fun](https://ornn.chrono-ai.fun) to browse and search skills directly. Or use the [Codex desktop app](https://openai.com/index/codex/) to get started without a terminal.

## How It Works

```
Your AI Agent (Claude Code / Codex / Cursor)
  ↓
NyxID (connectivity + credential injection)
  ↓
Ornn (skill search + install + sync)
  ↓
Skills execute → You get results
```

Ornn is NyxID's built-in skill management service. When you install NyxID, Ornn is already connected. Your skills sync across every device where NyxID is installed.

## Features

::: {.features-grid}
::: {.feature-card}
### Skill Search

Find skills by what they do, not what they're called. Semantic search plus keyword search plus category browsing.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Sandbox Playground

Test any skill before installing it. Interactive playground with Node.js and Python runtimes.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Cross-Device Sync

Install a skill on your laptop, use it on your desktop. Your skill library follows you everywhere.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Multi-Platform

Works with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, and Antigravity. One skill library, any agent.
:::
:::

## Build & Share Your Own Skills

Create custom skills and publish them to Ornn. Other users discover and use them instantly. The complete skill lifecycle: create, validate, publish, discover, execute.
